systemicFinding: The repair author corrected many cited defects and all mechanics pass, but several entries repair only the occurrence named in the prior review. Fresh whole-entry reading still finds respondent-as-utterer reversals, title/TOC evidence retained after relabeling it impersonal, recoverable speakers left generic, and explanations naming stale or absent masters. Formal exactness cannot certify semantic ownership.
